review_candidates.title: Customer Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location. Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp. Your Mission You keep business-critical processes running, and you make sure they keep running better. Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. When something does not behave the way a customer expected, a document that did not post, an exception that should have resolved itself, a number that looks wrong, it comes to our Customer Support Engineering team. Critical incidents are always solved, for every customer. On our strategic accounts we go further: priority handling, tracked response times, and the extra mile on topics we would otherwise push back on. As a Customer Support Engineer , you own incoming cases end to end. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires, and you fix it: you have the access and the authority to change configuration when that is the answer, and you know who to bring in when it is not. You are the person the customer hears back from, in writing, on a call, and increasingly in the room when something urgent needs solving now. You start on cases where the pattern is known and take on harder ones as your expertise builds. As a Senior Customer Support Engineer , you take the hard technical problems on live systems: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right. Everything difficult that comes out of the run phase lands with you. Two things sit alongside the case work, and they are what make this a senior job rather than a harder version of a junior one. Stabilizing accounts. When an account's health goes bad, you go in and stabilize it. Not as a permanent assignment, but as a small, highly skilled squad that takes a customer whose numbers or whose confidence have slipped, works out what is actually wrong across the whole picture, fixes it, and hands back a customer who is running properly again. Key Responsibilities Own customer cases end to end: investigate, resolve, and confirm with the customer that it is actually fixed. Diagnose across boundaries: platform behaviour, ERP behaviour, master data and process logic. Decide what the real fix is, and make it: configuration, data, process, or a case for engineering. Keep response times within our commitments, with priority handling on strategic accounts. Recognize when a problem is bigger than one case, and hand it on with proper evidence. Document what you learn so the next person does not have to learn it twice. Support Consultants and Client Partners on the technical substance of customer escalations. In addition, as a Senior Customer Support Engineer Own the technically difficult cases from our live customer base to a verified root cause. Go into accounts with a deteriorating health score, stabilize them and hand them back running properly. Drive strategic initiatives that permanently reduce effort and improve the customer experience, from better diagnostics to customer-facing self-service and assistants. Act as the counterpart to Product and Engineering, with evidence strong enough to change priorities, and push for structural problems to be solved once. Build the diagnostic tooling, patterns and documentation that raise what the rest of the team can resolve alone. Mentor interns and Customer Support Engineers, and raise the technical bar of the function. What You Bring For the Senior Customer Support Engineer level Master's degree in a STEM field: computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, physics or similar. 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: application support at depth, technical consulting, solution engineering, integration engineering or equivalent. Demonstrable debugging ability across systems, not only within one. APIs, data mapping, interfaces, logs. Comfortable with data. SQL or equivalent, and the instinct to check rather than assume. German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English. Nice to have: ERP experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or similar, scripting in any language, or exposure to workflow automation and process mining. Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact. Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

Blend your strong front-end engineering expertise; React and modern web technologies, with hands-on localization engineering. You will enjoy building scalable interfaces while shaping how products reach a global audience. Create user interfaces that work seamlessly across languages and regions. Help design, build, and evolve our localization processes to ensure internationalization is embedded into the front-end from the start. Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA , CO , CT , FL , GA , *IL , KS , MA , MD, ME , NJ , NC , NY , OH, OR , TN , TX , VA , and WA . We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option. Onsite interviews may be required for this role. What You’ll Be Doing Front-end & Localization Engineering: Apply your front-end engineering expertise to design, implement, and maintain scalable internationalized UI solutions. Work directly in the codebase to integrate localization into React components, manage localization files, and make UI and architectural adjustments that preserve performance, accessibility, and translation quality. Continuously evaluate and adopt tools and technologies that improve localization workflows, scalability, and developer experience. UI Localization Implementation & QA: Extract and manage new or updated UI strings, coordinate translation efforts with internal teams and external vendors, respond to translator questions, and ensure translations are correctly implemented in the front-end. Validate localized builds across languages and regions, support localization QA and bug reporting processes, and partner with engineers and designers to resolve UI, layout, and functional issues related to localization. Cross-functional Localization Ownership: Serve as a key front-end–focused point of contact for localization across the product, with a strong emphasis on international customer experience. Independently identify, investigate, and resolve localization and internationalization issues throughout the UI. Manage localization readiness for each product release and act as a technical bridge between Front-end Engineering, Localization, Design, and other stakeholders, ensuring clear, effective communication and smooth delivery of localized features. Other Duties as needed. About You Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science or Engineering. 3+ years of professional experience in front-end or software engineering roles. 2+ years working with React, JavaScript, and CSS. Localization engineering experience including internationalization, localization, adaptive UI, and responsive design principles. You are Bilingual, with strong verbal and written communication skills in English and at least one additional language. Experience building component-based, reusable UI components, using design systems and tools such as Figma and Storybook or others. Working knowledge of Python, including basic automation scripting or development workflows. Experience with localization-related workflows, including Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) tools. Familiarity with front-end testing frameworks and an understanding of how and why to write effective test cases. Strong collaborator who can effectively bridge diverse teams across cultures and facilitate seamless cross-departmental cooperation. Highly self-sufficient and proactive, comfortable independently managing projects from start to finish. Experience working in a fast-paced environment and can effectively prioritize tasks and projects. About Us NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for more than 40,000 customers in 140+ countries. The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years. What You’ll Love Our flexible working hours with home office options enable you to successfully balance your personal life and your job. Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally. Develop your skills through our renowned training platform. Receive competitive compensation. Collaborate with an amazing international workforce. Additional Information This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship. Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $65,000 to $100,000 per year. For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $65,000 to $100,000 per year.
